observations.quote: Právnici úradu v prvom štvrťroku posudzovali 72 prípadov, z ktorých 32 spadalo do pôsobnosti úradu podľa zákona č. 54/2019 Z. z.
observations.notes: Of the 72, those within the Office's remit under Act 54/2019.

observations.notes: Share of the 32 in-remit cases: employer wanted to change place of work or cut pay.

events.title: Australia passes corporate and tax whistleblower protection law (no rewards)
events.description: Parliament passes the Treasury Laws Amendment (Enhancing Whistleblower Protections) Act 2019, extending corporate whistleblower protections and creating a tax whistleblower regime; it contains no reward scheme and requires a review five years after commencement.
events.location: PDF p. 3 (printed 2) and response to Recommendation 12.11, PDF p. 22
events.quote: The Whistleblower Act passed by Parliament on 19 February 2019 extends the corporate whistleblower protections in the Corporations Act 2001 (Corporations Act) and introduces a new protection regime for tax whistleblowers

events.title: Slovak Whistleblower Protection Office opens
events.description: The Úrad na ochranu oznamovateľov, set up under Act 54/2019, starts operating; it protects whistleblowers, takes reports and decides on rewards.
events.quote: Úrad na ochranu oznamovateľov začal oficiálne fungovať a ponúkať svoje služby 2. septembra 2021.

events.title: Slovak whistleblower act amended to transpose the EU directive
events.description: Amendment of Act 54/2019 (passed May 2023) widens who is protected, raises fines (from EUR 2,000 to 6,000; up to EUR 100,000 for employers) and names the Office, prosecution and administrative bodies as external channels; sanction provisions apply from 1 September 2023. Reward rules are not described as changed.
events.quote: Novela nadobudla účinnosť 1. júla 2023, no niektoré jej ustanovenia, ktoré sa týkajú interných systémov oznamovania a sankcií až 1. septembra 2023.

events.title: Interior ministry suspends 11 protected police whistleblowers without the Office's consent
events.description: The Ministry of Interior temporarily removed from service 11 police officers holding protected-whistleblower status without asking the Office first; the Office opened administrative proceedings.
events.quote: Bez predchádzajúceho súhlasu ÚOO dočasne postavilo mimo výkonu štátnej služby 11 policajtov, ktorí mali status chráneného oznamovateľa.

events.title: New Slovak government approves fast-track amendment narrowing whistleblower protection
events.description: The government approves, without consultation, a draft that would narrow 'qualified report', let employers seek review of protections, exclude police and allow retroactive revision of protections; not debated in parliament by end-2023.
events.quote: 6. decembra 2023 vláda odsúhlasila návrh novely, ktorej nepredchádzala žiadna odborná a vecná diskusia.

events.title: Fast-track amendment to Slovak whistleblower act withdrawn
events.description: The government's December 2023 fast-track amendment narrowing whistleblower protection is withdrawn from parliament at the end of February 2024.
events.quote: Novela bola z rokovania parlamentu stiahnutá koncom februára 2024.

events.title: Whistleblower Office fines interior ministry EUR 90,000
events.description: First-instance fine of EUR 90,000 on the Ministry of Interior for acting against protected police whistleblowers without consent; upheld in October 2024, paid, and challenged in the administrative court.
events.quote: Jeho výsledkom bola doteraz najvyššia úradom udelená pokuta, 90-tisíc eur, o ktorej v júni rozhodol prvostupňový orgán úradu.

events.title: Slovak parliament passes fast-track law abolishing the Whistleblower Protection Office
events.description: The Act on the Office for the Protection of Victims of Crime and Whistleblowers, to replace the Office from 1 January 2026, end its leadership's mandate and allow review and withdrawal of protections, is passed; the president vetoes it on 11 December and parliament overrides the veto on 12 December 2025.
events.quote: Zákon bol v skrátenom legislatívnom konaní schválený 9. decembra 2025. Nové pravidlá mali začať platiť od 1. januára 2026.

events.title: Constitutional Court suspends the law abolishing the Whistleblower Protection Office
events.description: On a petition by 63 opposition MPs the Constitutional Court suspends the new law; the Office continues unchanged.
events.quote: Dňa 17. decembra 2025 Ústavný súd SR pozastavil účinnosť schváleného zákona.

events.title: European Commission opens infringement over abolition of Slovak Whistleblower Office
events.description: The Commission opens infringement proceedings over the new law; a EUR 590 million Recovery Plan payment is held back.
events.quote: Dňa 30. januára 2026 Európska komisia informovala o začatí konania pre porušenie práva EÚ (tzv. infringement)

events.title: Slovak coalition agrees to repeal the law abolishing the Office
events.description: Prime minister announces the coalition will repeal the new law, citing Recovery Plan payments.
events.quote: Premiér Robert Fico 4. marca 2026 po rokovaní vlády oznámil, že koalícia sa dohodla na zrušení nového zákona.
